picks.title: OpenAI's new business agents give brands a free way into the conversation it's also selling as an ad
picks.rationale: New launch (Businesses in ChatGPT / verified business agents): brands get a free organic presence plus click data inside the same conversation OpenAI sells as ad inventory, which reshapes how budgets split between owned agents and ChatGPT Ads.
picks.excerpt: OpenAI is giving brands a free route into ChatGPT conversations through verified business agents, while keeping control of the data and recommendations it also monetizes through ads.

picks.title: Shopify Noses Further Into Ad Tech With Campaign Autopilot Expansion
picks.rationale: Product expansion: Shopify's AI-run Campaign Autopilot uses merchant first-party data to buy ads, pushing commerce platforms into retail-media-style ad buying.
picks.excerpt: Shopify is expanding its AI-driven Campaign Autopilot ad product, using its first-party merchant data to push further into retail-media-style advertising.

picks.title: TikTok updates its AI video ad tools
picks.rationale: Tool release: TikTok Symphony now runs the latest Dreamina Seedance video model, directly changing what ad creatives brands can generate before the holiday push.
picks.excerpt: TikTok's Symphony ad-creation platform now has access to the latest Dreamina Seedance video model, expanding AI video ad creation options for brands.

picks.title: Priceline's AI agent Penny lands in Snapchat ads amid holiday rush
picks.rationale: New ad format in use: Priceline is the first travel brand on Snapchat's AI Sponsored Snaps, putting its own chatbot agent inside a paid ad unit.
picks.excerpt: Priceline is the first travel brand to use AI Sponsored Snaps, which let advertisers bring their own chatbots into Snapchat, putting its Penny AI agent in ads.

picks.title: Google Ads Tests A Weekly AI Report Card For Your Ad Creative
picks.rationale: New Google Ads test: an Asset activity page delivers weekly AI insight cards on ad creative, including headline ideas to test, which feeds straight into creative iteration.
picks.excerpt: Some Google Ads accounts show an Asset activity page that uses AI to deliver weekly insight cards on ad creative, including headline ideas to test.
